definitionZh: 如果你想对用户手势设置约束，那么你应该使用bounds选项。在这种情况下，**手势移动和偏移**都将被限制在指定的范围内。未设置时，bounds 将默认为 Infinity。
sourceDefinition: If you want to set constraints to the user gesture, then you should use the bounds option. In that case, **both** the gesture movement and offset will be clamped to the specified bounds. bounds will be defaulted to Infinity when not set.
